entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.35.0.6 to 30.35.0.7 (fork commit `4239b4821b57`, upstream v30.35.0), a verified delivery of the benchbox-sqlglot fork that adds the `exact_decimal_quotients` engine rewrite: it makes `CAST(x / y AS DECIMAL(p, s))` exact on DuckDB, which otherwise divides DECIMAL operands in DOUBLE and can round a half-cent tie the wrong way.
